reviews.review: Awesome rogue-like coop game with tons of items; tons of fun. YES, TONS.
Amazing action platformer with difficult that increases the longer you play the game. Also has good soundtrack.

although its kinda hard to actually see whats happening or running around on the screen, this game is damn fun.

plays a little like awesomenauts - 4 Abilities, 1 Base Attack + 3 Cooldown based specials, 10 Characters, each with an individual distinct playstyle, lots of funny and witty Items and challenges

and of course the best kind of difficulty theme there is - Pick Your Poison
the game gets progressively harder over time, starting up on Very Easy ans slowly switching over to Easy, normal, hard, very hard, insane and impossible. and thats still with 3 more difficulties to come.
you have to choose if you go through the levels fast (on normal Difficulty it takes ~5mins for the difficulty to rise) but possibly be underlevelled and underequipped later on, or to thouroghly search every level for the chests and Items everywhere to have a "full build"  to face the masses you have dragged behind you

its not getting boring for a good while.

Posted: 15 Nov, 2013 @ 4:23pm
I love the graphics, the monster index where you can see really great art of what something are supposed to be in case you can't quite tell (which you won't since most of the foes are original), there's a large list of items you can unlock but quite a lot are already unlocked as you start.
There's several very different characters with unique skills and attacks, some are range, some are melee, some charge up and so on.
The game is very difficult and even if you unlock absolutely nothing it's so fun to play it again.
Just don't wait around too much, every minute spent will make the foes tougher.

Posted: 23 March, 2015 @ 4:42pm

If you want to play it multiplayer, it's not worth buying because the multiplayer is a mess.
If you want to play it alone, you'll have a great time.

The devs have given up on this game though, little has been added since the first release.

+ Aesthetics
+ THE best soundtrack, composed by Chris Christadoulou
+ Wide variety of items that change the gameplay each playthrough
+ Replayability, unlock new items each game and have a new combination
+ Many characters to unlock, all having different powers and attacks
+ Multiplayer, adds so much more entertainment to the game

- Connecting with multiplayer partners is shoddy at best
- Latest version is far buggier than the first released version of the game (since 2014)

First off, this is not a roguelike, nor can it be said to have "roguelike elements" either. So stop calling it one.

It is a pure action game with randomly distributed items and premade levels that have semi-randomized structures. It is close to arcade design philosophy, but not quite. Luck plays too much of a factor in item generation, which can and will make or break runs (unless you play Huntress, because, regardless of what anyone may think or say on the matter, the ability to move while attacking puts her above everyone else in the cast) Yes, it is very possible to extend past the upper limit of the difficulty timer and become an absurd missile-spewing, marathon-running, never-dying asshat. But at that point you're more or less ruining whatever is left of the experience for yourself.

What puts me off most of all is the idea of unlockables, or first and foremost, the idea that you cannot experience the game at its best until you fulfill all sorts of weird "achievements". It puts me off partly because I know some of you are going to BAWW at me for downloading a complete save, when the fact is I just cannot be bothered to deal with this ♥♥♥♥. It's a lame excuse to wring more playtime out of the player, and the less we see of it the better. I'd rather everything be unlocked from the start and the upper difficulty limit to mean certain death, even for stupidly powerful characters, but what can I do? People are just too satisfied.

I only grudgingly recommend. Play it with others.
